responsibility: Primary target configuration header for the SH backend. It defines the architectural feature macros, default CPU/endianness selections, ABI and mode-switching policies, assembler and exception-handling macros, scheduling and reorg enums, pragma registration, promotion and calling-convention settings, and many other compile-time constants and hooks that parameterize both the generated machine-description code and the C++ backend implementation.
same_name_distinction: Defines the SH target's compile-time interface and configuration macros shared across the backend, unlike sh.cc which contains the hook implementations, sh.md which encodes instruction patterns/attributes in machine-description form, and sh.opt which is only the target option table.
